description: This Java source file defines the WebSocketRoute class which constructs and manages WebSocket endpoints for the application using Akka HTTP. It handles WebSocket upgrades, incoming and outgoing message flows, protocol-specific message parsing, signal enrichment, authorization, rate limiting, and supervision, integrating various components to facilitate real-time WebSocket communication within the service.
